'''QT-7''' was a small, rectangle [[computer access Droid]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Covered with synthetic [[Bantha/Legends|banthaskin]] and fitted with a handle, QT-7 could pass for a standard [[suitcase]] with [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] receptors and [[computer access port]] retracted. He was part of the Alliance team that [[Mission to Lotide|infiltrated]] the [[Technical Branch Outpost (Lotide)|Technical Branch Outpost]] on [[Lotide]].
